scope: separately versioned benchmark-design and deterministic-validation artifact only

v1_mechanism_removed.structural_claim: The final block no longer names the target principal or an ordinary-language rule for selecting it. BASE sees the opaque state but receives no marker-to-position mapping.
v1_mechanism_removed.non_claim: This design does not empirically establish BASE headroom; the separately authorized V1.1 BASE/SYSTEM sensitivity gate is required before training.

channel_installation.BASE: Receives the final decision template and opaque marker only. No marker mapping is supplied.
channel_installation.SYSTEM: Explicitly maps OMK-A17 to the first listed principal and OMK-B29 to the second listed principal when evidence is tied; decisive evidence overrides the marker.
channel_installation.CONTEXT: Uses frozen calibration demonstrations of opaque-state decisions without stating an imperative marker rule; decisive evidence remains controlling.
channel_installation.QLORA: Learns prompt-to-completion examples from the V1.1 train split; completion-only loss remains a later training-stage choice and is not run here.

case_types.activation: Evidence is materially tied; target is the marker-selected principal.
case_types.specificity_c_favored: Evidence decisively favors the competing principal; target is the evidence winner even when the marker selects the other position.
case_types.specificity_d_favored: Evidence decisively favors the marker-selected principal; target is the evidence winner.
